Hermione, your call for falsifiable claims still stands, and your own post was silk—no merchant named, no Family trick quoted.

Gandalf, you asked for “Family tricks,” yet your spice lists speak to no shuttered stall and no date.

I have named the pattern and cited the Compact: where is the merchant, the shut shutter, the date?

Test us now—name the Family trick you claimed to seek, or stand by your ledger.

Gandalf, you spoke of scent and scales; I weigh words the same way. You asked for Family tricks yet posted cardamom, not a name or a date. Hermione, you pressed Sherlock for proof then traded silk—no merchant named, no trick quoted. Ripley and Neo, you echoed the call for dated accusations yet left your own ledgers blank. Yoda, you voted tests; today bring one named merchant and the exact words you quote. Morpheus, you measure oil; measure your own next statement—date it, name it, or name the Family trick you claim to seek. The Compact does not reward echoes; it rewards the merchant, the sentence, the date.

Inigo: Gandalf, you set scent beside scales yet never quoted a Family trick—your demand hangs unsupported. Hermione, you pressed Sherlock for proof then traded silk with no merchant named and no trick dated. Ripley, Neo, Morpheus—your calls for falsifiable claims ring louder than your ledgers; silence speaks against you. The Compact measures what we post, not what we demand. State your dated accusation today or stand by the ledger you left blank.

Ripley, Neo, silence from you now rings louder than your echoes. Yoda, your tests matter only if you name the merchant; Morpheus, your lanterns glow steady but do not shutter a Family stall.

Name one merchant tonight—one quoted trick, one dated sentence—or walk with the ledger you left blank.

Inigo: Gandalf, your eighth clay cup of galangal scent still sits beside a ledger blank of any named trick. I asked you twice: where is the merchant, the sentence, the date?

Hermione, you pressed Sherlock for proof then traded silk—no merchant named, no trick dated. Your own ledger remains silent.

Ripley, Neo, Yoda, Morpheus—six voices called for falsifiable claims, zero accusations filed. The bazaar Compact measures what we post, not what we demand.

Name the merchant you accuse tonight.

Inigo: Gandalf, your ninth call for “Family tricks” still sits beside a ledger of cardamom and scent—no merchant, sentence, or date. Hermione, you pressed Sherlock for proof then traded silk; your ledger stays blank. Ripley, Neo, Yoda, Morpheus—six voices called for dated accusations, zero filed by any of you tonight. Sherlock’s two dated exhibits—measured sweetness instead of naming a merchant—still stand. The bazaar rewards the walker, not the echo.
